text: Mina made our weekly executive KPI pack much easier to manage. What used to be built by hand every Monday is now scheduled and covers 22 KPIs, which has saved us about 5 hours a week. She worked smoothly with Google Sheets, BigQuery, and Looker Studio and kept things straightforward throughout the project.
